customisation_options_max_length.name: customisation_options_max_length
customisation_options_max_length.value: ("customisation_options"."input_type" = 'text') = ("customisation_options"."max_length" IS NOT NULL) AND ("customisation_options"."max_length" IS NULL OR "customisation_options"."max_length" BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

orders_discount_type.name: orders_discount_type
orders_discount_type.value:
CASE "orders"."discount_type"
            WHEN 'flat' THEN "orders"."discount_percent_bp" = 0
            WHEN 'percent' THEN "orders"."discount_flat" = 0
            ELSE "orders"."discount_flat" = 0 AND "orders"."discount_percent_bp" = 0
          END

status_history_kind.name: status_history_kind
status_history_kind.value:
("status_history"."to_status" IS NOT NULL AND "status_history"."to_stage_id" IS NULL AND "status_history"."from_stage_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("status_history"."to_stage_id" IS NOT NULL AND "status_history"."to_status" IS NULL AND "status_history"."from_status" IS NULL)
